  > 玉玲瓏館之南為昭曠亭亭東南為映清齋齋東為鑑園敞宇五楹西嚮北為潄瓊齋其東為師善堂（長春園册）臣等謹案鑑園之後有船塢
  South of 玉玲瓏館: 昭曠亭, then 映清齋; east of it 鑑園, a five-bay range facing west, with 潄瓊齋 and 師善堂, and a boathouse behind.
- **E0305** (poem, sure): 御製 映清齋. 1772 (御製詩四集) · KR4f0005_282:4b-5a · S201. https://github.com/kanripo/KR4f0005/blob/master/KR4f0005_282.txt
  > 映清齋 迴廊彎似弓齋閣據當中三面全臨水八窻迥俯空近遥相（去聲）一合上下影相（平聲）同心境於何覔光光映鏡銅
  Form of the building: a gallery bent like a bow with the study at its centre, water on three sides and eight windows.
- **E0306** (poem, sure): 御製 映清齋. 1776 (御製詩四集) · KR4f0005_317:9b · S201. https://github.com/kanripo/KR4f0005/blob/master/KR4f0005_317.txt
  > 映清齋 弓様廻廊扇様齋溶溶池水緑侵階憑軒不必五絃撫一曲薫風早入懷
  Repeats the form: a bow-shaped gallery, a fan-shaped study, and green water up to the step.
- **E0302** (poem, sure): 映清斋. 乾隆三十一年 (1766) · v4 p.24, under 映清斋; source ref 9-204 · S361. https://www.yuanmingyuanpark.cn/xs/yjbg/202008/P020200803382796786124.pdf#page=27
  > 宛转回廊圆中规，纱疏面面俯临池。春风淡荡吹澜候，秋月高寒入影时。澄际堪因悟心性，照来恰复见须眉。如斯无尽藏佳处，久坐何曾刻漏移。
  Poem 映清斋 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1766, filed by the editors under 映清斋.
- **E0303** (poem, sure): 映清斋. 乾隆三十一年 (1766) · v4 p.26, under 映清斋; source ref 9-221 · S361. https://www.yuanmingyuanpark.cn/xs/yjbg/202008/P020200803382796786124.pdf#page=29
  > 回廊半浸水，水气入斋凉。互映色空际，含清上下光。契神于缥渺，得景即苍茫。物色与人意，相将报白藏。
  Poem 映清斋 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1766, filed by the editors under 映清斋.
- **E0311** (poem, sure): 昭旷亭. 乾隆三十一年 (1766) · v4 p.25, under 映清斋; source ref 9-205 · S361. https://www.yuanmingyuanpark.cn/xs/yjbg/202008/P020200803382796786124.pdf#page=28
  > 四柱虚亭不设棂，天容寥廓水清泠。适然俯仰得佳会，回绝寻常色与形。
  Poem 昭旷亭 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1766, filed by the editors under 映清斋.
- **E0304** (poem, sure): 映清斋. 乾隆三十二年 (1767) · v4 p.27, under 映清斋; source ref 9-342 · S361. https://www.yuanmingyuanpark.cn/xs/yjbg/202008/P020200803382796786124.pdf#page=30
  > 弓样游廊月样窗，一时清趣果无双。即声即色契真净，犹觉多言者个摐。
  Poem 映清斋 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1767, filed by the editors under 映清斋.
- **E0308** (description, sure): 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v4, editors' note on 映清斋. 2020 edition · v4 p.24 · S361. https://www.yuanmingyuanpark.cn/xs/yjbg/202008/P020200803382796786124.pdf#page=27

  海岳开襟: lake islet about 90 m across, about 1,000 m2 of buildings, by 1747, repaired 1778 and 1791; a totem park stood here 1995-2007. 映清斋: added 1766 as a new palace of 玉玲珑馆. 蒨园: 6,600 m2, 2,300 m2 of buildings, 1752. 鉴园: repaired 1810. 狮子林: west part with 丛芳榭 by 1747, the east in imitation of Suzhou finished 1772.
